title: Librarians are hosting viral ‘Avoiding AI’ workshops for people who are fed up with Big Tech
slides: Who would pay to avoid AI in 2025?
Librarians now host sold-out 'Avoiding AI' workshops.
The teacher? A librarian with zero tech background.
Attendees delete accounts and switch to paper calendars.
Your move: ask your local library for the next date.
thread_text:
Who pays to skip AI?

A sold-out workshop on 'Avoiding AI' just ended. The teacher had zero tech background.

The librarian as teacher

She teaches people to delete accounts and switch to paper calendars. No screens allowed.

Paper comes back

Attendees pay to unplug. The library can't keep up with demand for these workshops.

The real cost

People are willing to pay to avoid AI in 2025. It's not about fear—it's about buying back control.

Your move

Go to your local library and ask for the next 'Avoiding AI' workshop date. If they don't have one, ask why.

instagram.caption:
Sold-out workshops teaching people how to delete their online accounts and switch to paper calendars — and the instructor has zero tech background.  

The teacher is a librarian. Attendees pay to unplug. Libraries can’t keep up with demand.  

📚 This means the audience you target with AI-powered tools is actively choosing to opt out — and paying for the privilege.  

For your content: do you know who in your community already resents automation? Have you asked them what they want instead?
